description: This is a test class for the NotesDao component in an Android application, containing unit tests for database operations such as adding, deleting, updating, and querying notes and categories within a Room in-memory database.

classes.name: NotesDaoTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the NotesDao data access object in an Android Room database, focusing on CRUD operations and query methods related to notes and categories.

methods.name: setupDB
methods.description: Initializes an in-memory Room database and inserts a test account before each test.

methods.name: closeDb
methods.description: Closes the database after each test.

methods.name: deleteNoteById
methods.description: Tests deleting notes by ID and verifying their removal or retention based on status.

methods.name: updateScrollY
methods.description: Tests updating the scroll position of a note.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Tests updating the status of a note.

methods.name: updateStatus_NullConstraint
methods.description: Ensures that updating a note's status to null throws a SQLiteConstraintException.

methods.name: updateCategory
methods.description: Tests updating the category of a note.

methods.name: updateCategory_NullConstraint
methods.description: Ensures that updating a note's category to null throws a SQLiteConstraintException.

methods.name: getRemoteIds
methods.description: Tests retrieving remote IDs for notes associated with a specific account, ensuring uniqueness and filtering out notes from other accounts.

methods.name: getRemoteIdAndId
methods.description: Tests retrieving pairs of local and remote IDs, excluding deleted notes.

methods.name: getLocalIdByRemoteId
methods.description: Tests retrieving local note ID by remote ID, ensuring correct mapping and null for deleted notes.

methods.name: getFavoritesCount
methods.description: Tests counting favorite notes for an account, including reactive LiveData counts.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Tests counting total notes for an account, including reactive LiveData counts.

methods.name: getLocalModifiedNotes
methods.description: Tests retrieving notes that have been locally modified, excluding notes with VOID status.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Tests toggling the favorite status of a note.

methods.name: updateRemoteId
methods.description: Tests updating the remote ID of a note.

methods.name: updateIfNotModifiedLocallyDuringSync_NotModified
methods.description: Tests that no update occurs if the note has not been modified since last sync.

methods.name: updateIfNotModifiedLocallyDuringSync_ModifiedContent
methods.description: Tests that update is blocked if local content has been modified.

methods.name: updateIfNotModifiedLocallyDuringSync_ModifiedFavorite
methods.description: Tests that update is blocked if local favorite status has been modified.

methods.name: updateIfNotModifiedLocallyDuringSync_ModifiedCategory
methods.description: Tests that update is blocked if local category has been modified.

methods.name: updateIfNotModifiedLocallyAndAnyRemoteColumnHasChanged_Nothing
methods.description: Tests that no update occurs if remote columns have not changed.

methods.name: updateIfNotModifiedLocallyAndAnyRemoteColumnHasChanged_Nothing_ETagWasAndIsNull
methods.description: Tests that no update occurs if ETag was null and remains unchanged.

methods.name: updateIfNotModifiedLocallyAndAnyRemoteColumnHasChanged_Nothing_ETagWasNullButChanged
methods.description: Tests that update occurs if ETag was null but has changed.

methods.name: updateIfNotModifiedLocallyAndAnyRemoteColumnHasChanged_Modified
methods.description: Tests that update occurs if remote columns have changed.

methods.name: updateIfNotModifiedLocallyAndAnyRemoteColumnHasChanged_Title
methods.description: Tests updating the title when remote columns have changed.

methods.name: updateIfNotModifiedLocallyAndAnyRemoteColumnHasChanged_Favorite
methods.description: Tests updating the favorite status when remote columns have changed.

methods.name: updateIfNotModifiedLocallyAndAnyRemoteColumnHasChanged_Category
methods.description: Tests updating the category when remote columns have changed.

methods.name: updateIfNotModifiedLocallyAndAnyRemoteColumnHasChanged_ETag
methods.description: Tests updating the ETag when remote columns have changed.

methods.name: updateIfNotModifiedLocallyAndAnyRemoteColumnHasChanged_Content
methods.description: Tests updating the content when remote columns have changed.

methods.name: updateIfNotModifiedLocallyAndAnyRemoteColumnHasChanged_Excerpt
methods.description: Tests that excerpt changes do not prevent updates.

methods.name: updateIfNotModifiedLocallyAndAnyRemoteColumnHasChanged_ContentChangedButWasLocalEdited
methods.description: Ensures no update if local note was already marked as edited.

methods.name: updateIfNotModifiedLocallyAndAnyRemoteColumnHasChanged_ContentChangedButWasLocalDeleted
methods.description: Ensures no update if local note was marked as deleted.

methods.name: getCategoriesLiveData
methods.description: Tests retrieving live data of categories with counts, filtering by account.

methods.name: searchCategories
methods.description: Tests searching categories with prefix matching for different accounts.

methods.name: searchRecentByModified
methods.description: Tests retrieving recent notes filtered by modification date and title, sorted by favorite.

methods.name: isSortedByFavorite
methods.description: Helper method to verify if notes are sorted by favorite status.

methods.name: setupSecondAccount
methods.description: Creates and inserts a second account for testing purposes.

methods.name: setupSecondAccountAndTestNotes
methods.description: Creates a second account and populates it with various notes for testing filtering and categorization.
